verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documented bulk-operation capability, such as batch-terminating or batch-modifying many instances or resources in a single action. The Lambda Cloud API, 1-Click Cluster provisioning, and workspace-wide firewall rules are adjacent features, not bulk operations over many items. The S3 adapter for rclone/s5cmd relies on user-side third-party tools.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
